source.rationale: Falling through would emit 'No file is attached to that promotion', which describes a different situation. With a one-row list the sentence must read 'There is only 1 promotion' — the singular arms of both the verb and the plural-s. Nothing is sent and NO roster is published, so a stray follow-up number cannot pick an invisible row.

json.response: There is only 1 promotion in that list, please reply with a number between 1 and 1.
